content.comment_body: I updated my [product_name] software from version 7 to 8.1 and then 8.3. Is there a newer version available? I keep receiving a message saying I need a newer version of the software when I attempt to transfer a program to my [product_name] device. The device I'm currently using is: [product_name] BM [article_no] 1P [article_no] S [article_no] 2020

Which [product_name] model exactly do you have? Please provide the complete article number. It seems that the '1P' in the article number is unusual... You have [product_name] [version_no] ([article_no]). Which [product_name] did you select in the device settings? In [product_name] V8.3, you need to choose '[product_name] 8.1 & 8.2 ([product_name] 8.FS4)'.
I have a pre-made program, and it's [article_no].standard. Should I update the hardware selection to [product_name] 8.fs4?

Right, I changed it to [product_name] 8.fs4. It still didn't work; same error message appears. Could the hardware itself be the reason? Previously, I programmed this type of [product_name] device without switching the hardware setting when I was using version 8.1.
That's what you mentioned earlier. Do you now have [product_name] V8.3 installed?

Yes, I have V8.3 now. In my previous message, I was referring to about a year ago when I had version 8.1 and the same device. At that time, I kept the hardware as [article_no].original and it worked fine. Currently, this new hardware isn't working with anything. Following the steps in your screenshot, I changed the hardware to [product_name] 8.fs4, saved it, and tried transferring from PC to device, but it still requests a newer version.

I've used the following [product_name] devices: - [product_name] 8.0 ([article_no].Standard) - [product_name] 8.2 ([product_name] 8.FS4) - [product_name] 8.3 ([product_name] 8.3) I can program all of these devices and transfer programs using [product_name] V8.3 without any error messages.

I just tested a [product_name] [article_no] and kept the hardware setting at [article_no] — it worked perfectly with [product_name] V8.3. This makes me suspicious that the issue may be with the hardware itself. Any suggestions are welcome.
Sorry, I can't assist further. Maybe other forum members can help.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing a recurring issue, receiving a message that a newer software version is required when transferring programs to their [product_name] device. Although updating [product_name] software from version 7 to 8.3 and selecting the correct hardware in the software, the problem persists. Previous software-hardware combinations did not trigger this error, suggesting possible confusion or compatibility issues between firmware and software, or misleading status messages within the software interface.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that updating both the device firmware and programming software, or properly selecting the corresponding hardware, should guarantee compatibility and allow smooth program transfers without encountering version mismatch errors.
